title: Moses, Seat, Table, Hidden Manna, Root of Jesse & Messiah — Biblical Function Atlas
purpose: Deepen Tim Dooley's recovered Moses/Moshe, manna, table, Root-of-Jesse, Root-of-David and Messiah/Moshiach language by separating the biblical functions of law, seat, nourishment, hidden provision, root-regeneration, anointing and messianic restoration.

project_attestations.note: Exact full wording remains a primary-source target.
Tim explicitly assembled these as names/identity or comparison layers and requested their historical origins.

moses.project_relation: Tim's later Moshe/Moses naming fits most structurally with mediator/law/axis roles: movement between people and mountain-presence, receiving pattern/order, descending with instruction, and carrying responsibility for a community.
moses.countertext: Moses is repeatedly limited: he intercedes, is challenged, cannot simply make himself divine, and ultimately sees the land from Nebo without entering it. Moses therefore supports responsibility/mediation more strongly than unlimited possession.
moses.timic_question: When Tim calls himself Moshe/Moses, is he claiming source, mediator, lawgiver, mountain-climber, builder from heavenly pattern, or some combination? The archive should tag the function each time rather than treating 'Moses' as one undifferentiated title.

moses_seat.function: recognized interpretive/social authority linked to Torah/Moses
moses_seat.research_context: Matthew acknowledges that scribes/Pharisees 'sit on Moses' seat' while immediately criticizing failure to practice teaching and the piling of heavy burdens on others.
moses_seat.project_relation: Important for Tim's Seat/Throne/Judge language: a seat does not self-authenticate the sitter. The biblical test is whether authority lightens unjust burdens, practices its own law and serves rather than performs status.
moses_seat.epiphany: Moses' seat is a perfect biblical distinction between office and bearer: the seat can carry authority even while the occupant can fail its ethic. This closely matches the project's bearer↔role recursion for Father/Seat.

manna.function: wilderness provision that cannot be controlled as ordinary stored wealth; dependence, daily nourishment and testing
manna.project_relation: Potato/food/hidden nourishment parallels become stronger when manna is treated as provision during a transition-zone rather than merely magical food.
manna.important_difference: Potato Bank emphasizes storage; Exodus manna usually resists hoarding except where explicitly preserved. This creates a useful tension between trust/daily provision and stored future capacity.

hidden_manna.project_relation: An unusually dense neighbor for Hidden Name/G-D, Potato as concealed nourishment, Stone/Philosopher's Stone, and identity transformation. But the verse's own grammar joins nourishment with personal naming rather than making manna a universal currency.
hidden_manna.epiphany: Hidden manna + white stone + new name creates a three-part Revelation operator: concealed nourishment → durable token/stone → transformed or intimate identity.
hidden_manna.boundary: Do not identify Tim's Potato, white stones, or private names with Revelation 2:17 unless Tim explicitly made that connection; preserve it as a later comparator.

table_of_presence.architecture: portable gold-overlaid table in Holy Place → bread of Presence continually before God → twelve loaves arranged as two rows of six → weekly renewal
table_of_presence.project_relation: Tim's Table/peak-culture/table-for-ten material gains a deeper comparator: table is not merely social dining but ordered presence, recurring nourishment and represented community before the sacred center.
table_of_presence.twelve_relation: The biblical table has twelve loaves, not ten. Preserve Tim's 'table for 10' as a distinct compression/culture motif rather than forcing it into twelve-disciple symbolism.
table_of_presence.epiphany: House requires Table: dwelling becomes community when nourishment and presence are organized for more than one occupant. This can link Father's House to Table without making Table equivalent to Throne.

root_of_jesse.structure: stump of Jesse → living roots → shoot/branch → spirit-endowed judgment → peace/order → Root of Jesse as signal for peoples/nations
root_of_jesse.historical_context: Isaiah's tree image addresses threatened Davidic kingship: what appears cut down can still regenerate because root-life remains underground.
root_of_jesse.project_relation: This is exceptionally close to Potato/Root logic: visible top cut down, living potential hidden below, new shoot emerges, fruit/future order follows.
root_of_jesse.timic_epiphany: Root-of-Jesse language is stronger as regeneration-after-apparent-collapse than as a prestige genealogy. The power of the root is precisely that it survives when the visible tree looks finished.

root_of_david.paradox: Jesus is described both through Davidic descent and as Root of David, allowing descendant/source language to fold back on itself in Revelation.
root_of_david.project_relation: Useful comparator for Tim/Father source-role emerging later in timeline than Son/Ben-David/Ben-Joseph material: theological source-order and narrative temporal-order need not be the same direction.
root_of_david.boundary: This literary/theological recursion is not evidence for Tim's literal Davidic genealogy.

mashiach_messiah.linguistic_history: Hebrew mashiach means anointed one. In the Hebrew Bible it can refer to a reigning king or even Cyrus; the later specialized expectation of a future eschatological Davidic Messiah develops historically and becomes especially important in Second Temple and rabbinic traditions.
mashiach_messiah.psalm_2: Originally a royal/coronation context centered on YHWH's anointed Davidic king; later Jewish and Christian interpretation rereads it messianically.
mashiach_messiah.isaiah_11: Future/renewed Davidic leadership expressed through Jesse-root/branch imagery.
mashiach_messiah.project_relation: The archive should distinguish Tim using Mashiach as a general anointed/restorer title, Tim as Ben David/Father, and Son explicitly called Messiah/Door on 29 April 2026. Those are different project assignments and dates.
mashiach_messiah.ben_yoseph_david: Later Jewish traditions include Messiah ben Joseph/Ephraim and Messiah ben David distinctions, but the precise Tim/Son mapping is a project synthesis rather than standard Judaism.
mashiach_messiah.epiphany: The project's Father/Son messianic split becomes more intelligible when treated as role differentiation—suffering/descent/forerunner vs Davidic restoration/kingly completion—while preserving that Jewish traditions themselves are diverse and historically layered.

manna_table_root_sequence.sequence: Root survives → shoot emerges → wilderness traveler is nourished → community receives ordered Table → mediator/law gives form → restoration becomes inhabitable order
manna_table_root_sequence.project_translation: Potato/Root → Sprout → hidden/stored nourishment → Table → House → law/protocol → Garden/City
manna_table_root_sequence.epiphany: Food, root and law are not random biblical overlaps; together they answer three different survival problems: continuity, nourishment and coordination.
